title: Getting Buck out of Clay Street School
summary: On Tape 2 he tells the principal he wants Ford Lee Washington out of school to pursue piano and show business in New York.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Sure we'd like to go to New York. Yes, I'll get my mother and all to get an okay to sign the contracts. Okay. Thank you. So I'm now on my way to the Principal of the school where Buck goes which is called The Clay Street School and I see the Principal and I tell him like it relly was. I says, my name is John W. Sublette from School No. 17 and I would like to get Ford Lee Washington out of school because he has such marvelous hands on the piana, there ain't nothing he's going to learn in this school that's going to do him as much good as his talent in the field and we have a chance now to go to New York, the only opportunity we have to get to New York before we have a chance to go into show business like we should. And I could appreciate no end if I could get him out for that purpose, 'cause he ain't going to learn much in school, much more, what's he going to do with it after he learns it? Says I to he. 'Cause things were critical for

an education let alone talent, what you can't get with education you can get with talent, but you've got to have superb talent to get anywhere and you have to have a college education same as what's-his-name, Paul Robeson or Frederick Douglass or Booker T. (Washington). You have to have a certain education to get anywhere. But, however, the Principal said, who's going to take care of Madd Washington? I says, I will take care of him. He said, you go home and get a paper from his mother to make sure you're his guardian and I'll let him out. And that was as easy as pie.
